title: With a live database clock the setup still had to reach the lock wait within the token lifetime, so a slow host could fail the test
resolution: The test enrolls through credentials whose clock_timestamp() is a stepped clock that stands still until the barrier sees the lock wait, so no setup time counts.

title: A failed assertion or poll left the row lock held and both test connections open, which would block the next test
resolution: A finally block ends both connections, which releases the lock, and waits for the enrollment; a run with a barrier that never matches failed only this test.

title: The lag reproduction claimed a failure every time and named the wrong reference clock for its offset
resolution: The record and the design say it failed in both recorded runs, give its 100 ms margin, and state that it lags the real database clock.

title: The scope counted two test helpers where the diff added three
resolution: The scope names the current helpers of the reworked test.

title: Verification tasks were unticked and the remaining gates named only the integration
resolution: Tasks are ticked as their checks complete, and the remaining gates name the pending review and archive.
